# Hub v2 V6: the big bot scene

Step 6 of 7 of Hub v2. Needs V1. Read PROJECT-BRIEF.md first, then `hub/web/bot.js`, `hub/activity.js` and the approved mock `hub/design/hub-v2-mock.html` (its script draws every pose; if that file is missing, stop and say so). No model call anywhere: the bot reads `/api/activity`, which the hub already serves. Hub files only.

## Goal
The corner bot stays. While the hub works, the bot walks along the bottom edge to the free space at the bottom right, grows, and acts out what is happening. When nothing runs it shrinks, wanders and sometimes naps. Clicking it opens the live list. It costs no tokens.

## Build
1. `hub/activity.js`: add `scene` to the answer, worked out from the same feed events: `idle`, `think` (working, no tool yet), `read` (Read, Grep, Glob), `write` (Edit, Write), `test` (Shell running npm test, release, check or index), `wait` (mood question), `stopped`, `done` (a run finished and its result waits). Add `target` (the file or command name the feed already shows) and, for `test`, nothing more: the board is an animation, not a count of real tests.
2. `hub/web/bot-scene.js`: pure rules (tested) `sceneOf(activity)`, `homeX(width)`, `scaleFor(scene, width)`, `stepBot(bot, dt, width)` (walk to the stage when working, wander with pauses and naps when idle), ported from the mock; and the canvas drawing, ported from the mock pose by pose: thinking (bubble), reading (book with turning page, paper stack), writing (desk, screen with lines being typed), testing (lamp board filling, clipboard), waiting (sign "I need you", waving, wide eyes), done (jump, confetti), stopped (sitting, antenna red, a small "stopped" sign), nap. Colours come from the CSS variables, so the accent follows the weekly gauge.
3. `hub/web/bot.js` and `hub.css`: a canvas fixed along the bottom of the window from the rail to the right edge, 250 px high, behind page content and not catching clicks except on the bot itself. On a window 1100 px or wider the big scene plays at the bottom right, in the space V1 keeps free. Below 1100 px there is no big scene: the present corner face and speech line stay exactly as they are. The speech line keeps the existing `lineOf` text, placed above the bot. A click on the bot opens the existing live list beside it; a second click closes it. The existing fold-away state still hides everything but the face.
4. Cost limits: draw at most 30 frames a second; do not draw while the tab is hidden; when the scene is `idle` and the bot is napping, draw 4 frames a second; with "reduce motion" on, draw one still pose per change and never animate. Poll `/api/activity` at the existing rates (2 s working, 10 s idle), no faster.
5. Tests: `tests/hub-bot-scene.mjs` (scene from feed events for each tool, question and stopped states, walking reaches the stage and stops, wander stays inside the window, scale small when idle, reduce-motion path draws once) using a stub canvas. Add screenshots to `scripts/hub-shots.mjs`: working (writing), waiting for you, idle, at 1400 px, and one at 800 px showing the unchanged corner bot.

## Rules
- The scene shows names and counts only, never the model's words.
- Nothing may cover page content or buttons at any width.
- No BOM. Run `npm test` after each change; finish with `npm run index`, then `npm test`. Stop with tests passing; report failures honestly and say that motion was not seen in a real browser unless it was. Do not commit.

## Done when
On a wide window the bot walks to the bottom right and acts out reading, writing, testing, waiting and finishing from the real activity feed; on a narrow window nothing changed; it stops drawing when hidden; tests pass.

## Run

why: ports the approved animated mock into the hub against tests
size: M
needs: test, check, index

# Hub v2 V6: the big bot scene (the panda)

Step 6 of 7 of Hub v2. Needs V1. Read PROJECT-BRIEF.md first, then `hub/web/bot.js`, `hub/activity.js` and the approved panda `hub/design/hub-v2-panda.js` (the drawing and motion code from the design page; if that file is missing, stop and say so). No model call anywhere: the bot reads `/api/activity`, which the hub already serves. Hub files only.

## Goal
The hub's bot is a panda (decided by the owner, 2026-11-11): soft, round, big shiny eyes, smooth in every movement. While the hub works, the panda walks along the bottom edge to the free space at the bottom right, grows, and acts out what is happening. When nothing runs it shrinks, wanders, eats bamboo and naps. Clicking it opens the live list. It costs no tokens. The small corner face in the rail becomes the panda's face too.

## Build
1. `hub/activity.js`: add `scene` to the answer, worked out from the same feed events: `idle`, `think` (working, no tool yet), `read` (Read, Grep, Glob), `write` (Edit, Write), `test` (Shell running npm test, release, check or index), `wait` (mood question), `stopped`, `done` (a run finished and its result waits). Add `target` (the file or command name the feed already shows). The test board is an animation, not a count of real tests: label it with the command name, not with numbers.
2. `hub/web/bot-scene.js`, ported from `hub/design/hub-v2-panda.js` and kept as close to it as possible (same shapes, colours, timing and the same "pose glides toward a target" method: do not simplify it into fixed frames):
   - pure rules (tested): `sceneOf(activity)`, `homeX(width)`, `scaleFor(scene, width)`, `stepBot(bot, dt, width)` (walk to the stage with easing when working; wander with pauses, bamboo and naps when idle), `target(scene, tt, t)` (the pose for each scene) and `glide(pose, target, dt)`;
   - drawing: the panda (ears, head, eye patches, eyes with highlights and blinking, nose, mouth, cheeks, body with breathing, belly, collar with the mood light, arms, feet with pads when sitting), and each scene's props: thinking (bubble), reading (book with turning page, paper stack), writing (desk, glowing screen with lines being typed), testing (lamp board filling, clipboard), waiting (sign "I need you", waving, wide eyes), done (jump, confetti), nap, bamboo. Add one scene the mock lacks: `stopped` (sitting, ears drooped, mood light red, a small sign with the stop reason from the existing `STOP_LINE` texts).
   - colours come from the CSS variables where the mock uses the accent, so the collar and glow follow the weekly gauge.
3. `hub/web/bot.js` and `hub.css`: a canvas fixed along the bottom of the window from the rail to the right edge, 250 px high, behind page content and not catching clicks except on the panda itself. On a window 1100 px or wider the big scene plays at the bottom right, in the space V1 keeps free. Below 1100 px there is no big scene: the corner face and speech line behave exactly as today, with the face redrawn as the panda's head (same moods). The speech line keeps the existing `lineOf` text, placed above the panda. A click on the panda opens the existing live list beside it; a second click closes it. The existing fold-away state still hides everything but the face.
4. Cost limits: draw at most 60 frames a second and skip frames when a frame took longer than 8 ms; do not draw while the tab is hidden; while napping draw 10 frames a second; with "reduce motion" on, draw one still pose per change and never animate. Poll `/api/activity` at the existing rates (2 s working, 10 s idle), no faster.
5. Tests: `tests/hub-bot-scene.mjs` (scene from feed events for each tool, question and stopped states, walking reaches the stage and stops, wander stays inside the window, scale small when idle, the pose reaches its target, reduce-motion path draws once) using a stub canvas. Add screenshots to `scripts/hub-shots.mjs`: writing, testing, waiting for you, stopped, idle, at 1400 px, and one at 800 px showing the corner face.

## Rules
- The scene shows names and counts only, never the model's words.
- Nothing may cover page content or buttons at any width.
- No BOM. Run `npm test` after each change; finish with `npm run index`, then `npm test`. Stop with tests passing; report failures honestly and say that motion was not seen in a real browser unless it was. Do not commit.

## Done when
On a wide window the panda walks to the bottom right and acts out reading, writing, testing, waiting, stopping and finishing from the real activity feed, as smoothly as on the design page; on a narrow window only the face changed; it stops drawing when hidden; tests pass.

# Hub v2 V6: the big bot scene (the panda)

Revision 3 (2026-11-11): ports panda pass 2 (the scene shows the feed's numbers: bamboo allowance, cache cup, test result, stop reason, bigger "needs you", file names, gauge mood). New text is in "Build" items 1, 2 and 6, in "Rules" and in "Done when".

Step 6 of 7 of Hub v2. Needs V1; the cache cup also needs V5 (without V5, build the cup hidden and say so). Read PROJECT-BRIEF.md first, then `hub/web/bot.js`, `hub/activity.js` and the approved panda `hub/design/hub-v2-panda.js` (the drawing and motion code from the design page; if that file is missing, stop and say so). No model call anywhere: the bot reads `/api/activity`, which the hub already serves. Hub files only.

## Goal
The hub's bot is a panda (decided by the owner, 2026-11-11): soft, round, big shiny eyes, smooth in every movement. While the hub works, the panda walks along the bottom edge to the free space at the bottom right, grows, and acts out what is happening. When nothing runs it shrinks, wanders, eats bamboo and naps. Clicking it opens the live list. It costs no tokens. The small corner face in the rail becomes the panda's face too.

## Build
1. `hub/activity.js`: add `scene` to the answer, worked out from the same feed events: `idle`, `think` (working, no tool yet), `read` (Read, Grep, Glob), `write` (Edit, Write), `test` (Shell running npm test, release, check or index), `wait` (mood question), `stopped`, `done` (a run finished and its result waits). Add `target` (the file or command name the feed already shows). The test board is an animation, not a count of real tests: while tests run, label it with the command name, not with numbers.
   Pass 2 adds `facts` to the answer, all names and counts the hub already has (the panda file calls this object `F`):
   - `used`, `cap`: the run's tokens and allowance (already in the answer as `tokens` and `cap`); `file` and `cmd` (from `target`).
   - scenes `pass` and `fail`, shown after a test command ends, until the next feed event: take the result and the counts (`total`, `fail`) from what the hub already records for a finished test job or shell call. FIRST check where that result lives; if the feed has no pass or fail result today, add only the exit result (passed or failed) from the tool event, show the scenes without numbers ("passed", "failed"), and say so in the report. Never parse the model's words.
   - `reason` for `stopped`: the run's status, one of the existing `STOP_LINE` keys (`capped`, `paused`, `interrupted`, `guard-stopped`, `failed`, `stopped`). Short sign texts: "Cap reached", "5-hour limit", "Interrupted", "Weekly limit", "No result", "Stopped by you". The mock shows only four of these; build all six.
   - `asks`: how many runs wait for the owner (question or second yes).
   - `cacheMin`: minutes since the last reply of the chat or run on show, from the times V5 stores. Use V5's measured cache lifetime for "cold"; if it is still unmeasured, the cup shows steam thinning over 60 minutes and the label says only "N min since last reply", never "cold".
   - `gauge`: the higher of the weekly and 5-hour percentages from the newest watcher reading the hub already shows at the top. No probe, no model call.
2. `hub/web/bot-scene.js`, ported from `hub/design/hub-v2-panda.js` and kept as close to it as possible (same shapes, colours, timing and the same "pose glides toward a target" method: do not simplify it into fixed frames):
   - pure rules (tested): `sceneOf(activity)`, `homeX(width)`, `scaleFor(scene, width)`, `stepBot(bot, dt, width)` (walk to the stage with easing when working; wander with pauses, bamboo and naps when idle), `target(scene, tt, t)` (the pose for each scene) and `glide(pose, target, dt)`;
   - drawing: the panda (ears, head, eye patches, eyes with highlights and blinking, nose, mouth, cheeks, body with breathing, belly, collar with the mood light, arms, feet with pads when sitting), and each scene's props: thinking (bubble), reading (book with turning page, paper stack), writing (desk, glowing screen with lines being typed), testing (lamp board filling, clipboard), waiting (sign "I need you", waving, wide eyes), done (jump, confetti), nap, bamboo. Add one scene the mock lacks: `stopped` (sitting, ears drooped, mood light red, a small sign with the stop reason from the existing `STOP_LINE` texts).
   - pass 2, ported the same way from the same file (functions `bamboo`, `cup`, `board`, `sign`, `fit`, the `worry` and `droop` pose values, and the gauge lines in `target` and `head`):
     - bamboo beside the stage = the run's allowance: grows to a dashed outline, amber notch and label at 80%, amber above it, red at the cap, the percentage on top; past 80% the panda glances at it. Hidden when the cap is unknown.
     - tea cup = the cache: steam while warm, thinner with the minutes, frosted blue when cold, a small label under it.
     - the file name on the book cover (reading) and on the screen's title bar (writing), the command name on the lamp board (testing); `fit()` cuts long names to the last path part with an ellipsis.
     - `pass`: green board, cheer, a little green confetti. `fail`: worried face, ears down, the failing lamps blink red, the count in red.
     - `stopped`: sits, ears down, red mood light, wooden sign with the short reason (this replaces the "small sign" above).
     - `wait`: the bigger sign with the count under it ("1 question"), two rings pulsing on the floor, the speech line in amber and bold. Also put the count in the page title ("(1) Mikkadr Hub") while anything waits.
     - gauge mood: under 60% nothing; from 60% a sweat drop and 1.35 times the work speed; from 90% half-closed eyes, 0.6 times the speed and slower walking. The gauges at the top stay the real reading.
     - pure rules added to the tested list: `fillOf(facts)`, `warmOf(facts, lifetime)`, `paceOf(gauge)`, `signText(reason)`, `fit(name, max, measure)`.
   - colours come from the CSS variables where the mock uses the accent, so the collar and glow follow the weekly gauge.
3. `hub/web/bot.js` and `hub.css`: a canvas fixed along the bottom of the window from the rail to the right edge, 250 px high, behind page content and not catching clicks except on the panda itself. On a window 1100 px or wider the big scene plays at the bottom right, in the space V1 keeps free. Below 1100 px there is no big scene: the corner face and speech line behave exactly as today, with the face redrawn as the panda's head (same moods). The speech line keeps the existing `lineOf` text, placed above the panda. A click on the panda opens the existing live list beside it; a second click closes it. The existing fold-away state still hides everything but the face.
4. Cost limits: draw at most 60 frames a second and skip frames when a frame took longer than 8 ms; do not draw while the tab is hidden; while napping draw 10 frames a second; with "reduce motion" on, draw one still pose per change and never animate. Poll `/api/activity` at the existing rates (2 s working, 10 s idle), no faster.
5. Tests: `tests/hub-bot-scene.mjs` (scene from feed events for each tool, question and stopped states, walking reaches the stage and stops, wander stays inside the window, scale small when idle, the pose reaches its target, reduce-motion path draws once) using a stub canvas. Add screenshots to `scripts/hub-shots.mjs`: writing, testing, waiting for you, stopped, idle, at 1400 px, and one at 800 px showing the corner face.
6. Sound (pass 2): a "Sound" toggle beside the bot, OFF by default, remembered in the browser. When on, one soft two-note chime (Web Audio, no file) plays once each time the number of things waiting for the owner goes up; never for anything else, never repeated. Test: the pure rule `shouldChime(before, after, soundOn)`.
7. Pass 2 tests and pictures: add to `tests/hub-bot-scene.mjs` the facts for each case (allowance at 0, 79, 80, 100%; each stop reason; pass and fail; cache warm and cold; gauge 36, 70, 92) and the pass 2 pure rules. Add screenshots: tests passed, tests failed, stopped at the cap, waiting with the big sign, allowance at 86%.

## Rules
- Pass 2 adds no new polling, no timer and no second canvas: the bamboo, cup and signs are drawn in the same frame as the panda (about 40 more shapes), inside the same 60-frame cap and 8 ms skip rule. With "reduce motion" on, they are drawn still (no steam movement, no blinking, no rings pulsing).
- The scene shows names and counts only, never the model's words.
- Nothing may cover page content or buttons at any width.
- No BOM. Run `npm test` after each change; finish with `npm run index`, then `npm test`. Stop with tests passing; report failures honestly and say that motion was not seen in a real browser unless it was. Do not commit.

## Done when
On a wide window the panda walks to the bottom right and acts out reading, writing, testing, waiting, stopping and finishing from the real activity feed, as smoothly as on the design page; the bamboo, cup, file names, test result, stop reason, big "needs you" sign and gauge mood match the real numbers the hub shows elsewhere on the page; the chime is silent until the owner turns Sound on; on a narrow window only the face changed; it stops drawing when hidden; tests pass.
